content:
name: 'ci: gates'
run-name: 'ci: gates'

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  wpt-scope:
    name: plan WPT coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Check whether WPT inputs changed
        id: plan
        shell: bash
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "$BASE_SHA" ] || [[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^0+$ ]]; then
            echo 'run=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! git cat-file -e "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null &&
            ! git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA"; then
            echo 'Base commit is unavailable; running WPT as a safe fallback.'
            echo 'run=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if ! changed_files="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")"; then
            echo 'Cannot compare commits; running WPT as a safe fallback.'
            echo 'run=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          while IFS= read -r file; do
            case "$file" in
              src/*|test/wpt/*|upstream/wpt|.gitmodules|.config/*)
                echo 'run=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                exit 0
                ;;
              .github/workflows/ci.yml|.github/actions/setup/action.yml|.github/actions/php/action.yml)
                echo 'run=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                exit 0
                ;;
              scripts/setup.mjs|scripts/package-manager.mjs|scripts/php.mjs|package.json|package-lock.json)
                echo 'run=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                exit 0
                ;;
            esac
          done <<< "$changed_files"
          echo 'run=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [22, 24]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test

  wpt:
    needs: wpt-scope
    if: needs.wpt-scope.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - parallel:
          - name: Install PHP for the WPT server
            uses: ./.github/actions/php
          - name: Prepare and verify pinned WPT checkout
            run: |
              npm run wpt:setup
              npm run wpt:verify
      - run: npm exec -- playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run wpt:test
